_comment: Detector models that are not in git. tools/install.ps1 downloads missing ones from the Hugging Face repo below (https://huggingface.co/<repo>/resolve/main/<file name>) and checks sha256 when it is set. The face models (retinaface, age_gender) are not listed: the entrance app downloads them itself on first start.

models.used_by: checkout pipeline, original export with NMS (only if config.yml points to it)
entrance pipeline, larger model (only if config.yml points to it)
